newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE TELECOM UPS 1996 DIVIDEND TO 180DRS.
newsitem.headline: OTE TELECOM UPS 1996 DIVIDEND TO 180DRS.

text.p: Greek telecom OTE will pay a higher dividend per share for fiscal 1996 -- 180 drachmas versus 130 a year earlier -- an increase of 38.5 percent, its board of directors decided on Wednesday.
OTE's 1996 income statement will show pretax profit of 250.2 billion drachmas, up 22.8 percent on 1995 when it posted 203.7 billion.
OTE will pay the Greek state taxes amounting to 98 billion drachmas, it said.
The telecoms is scheduled for a second 10.7 percent part-flotation in June following its successfull first attempt at 4,000 drachmas a share in April last year.
